# Policy for invite.nirmanpreet.com
#
# Two audiences pull this URL, and they want OPPOSITE things:
#
#   1. Link-preview crawlers - WhatsApp, iMessage, Facebook, Slack, Twitter,
#      Discord, Teams. They fetch the page and the og:image to build the card
#      a guest sees in the chat. They must be allowed in, or the invitation is
#      shared as a bare blue URL with no picture, no title and no date.
#
#   2. Search engines. This is a private invitation: two names, a home venue,
#      two phone numbers and a home town. It has no business in a search
#      result, so the search bots are kept out.
#
# CORRECTION - the previous version of this file said:
#
#   "The page itself carries <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">,
#    which is about SEARCH indexing, not fetching."
#
# That is the assumption that caused "shared on WhatsApp, no preview". It is
# true for most crawlers and false for the one that matters: the WhatsApp card
# is built by the Facebook crawler (facebookexternalhit), which can honour a
# blanket noindex and decline to generate a card at all. The <meta name="robots">
#   tag has since been replaced by googlebot/bingbot-specific directives in
#   build.js, and the same split is enforced here.
#
# Note the ordering: the most specific User-agent group wins, so Googlebot is
# Disallowed despite the blanket Allow below.

User-agent: Googlebot
Disallow: /

User-agent: Bingbot
Disallow: /

User-agent: DuckDuckBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: YandexBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: Baiduspider
Disallow: /

# Everyone else - every link-preview crawler, every browser - is welcome.
User-agent: *
Allow: /
